article_title: The Effect of Impulsivity vs. Reflectivity on Reading Comprehension of Iranian EFL Learners
citation: Shabani, S., Ramazani, M., & Alipoor, I. (2017). The Effect of Impulsivity vs. Reflectivity on Reading Comprehension of Iranian EFL Learners. International Journal of Education & Literacy Studies, 5(3), 52-56. http://dx.doi.org/10.7575/aiac.ijels.v.5n.3p.52
title: Xu's (2011) taxonomy of learning styles: perceptual, cognitive, and personality learning styles
description: The article draws on Xu's (2011) taxonomy which categorizes learning styles into three main categories: perceptual, cognitive, and personality learning styles. Perceptual styles relate to one's senses (visual, auditory, kinesthetic). Cognitive styles include field dependence vs. field independence. Personality styles include introversion vs. extroversion and impulsivity vs. reflectivity. The article focuses on personality learning styles, specifically impulsivity and reflectivity.
requirements: Understanding of individual learner differences in language learning contexts
constraints: Not all learning styles are relevant to language learning since language learning has unique characteristics
target_learning_goals: Understanding individual differences in language learning
